DIAGNOSIS: Isolated generalized dystonia with prominent cervical dystonia (laterocollis and rotacollis), most consistent with idiopathic adult-onset dystonia of presumed genetic/unknown cause

ALTERNATIVE: Functional neurological movement disorder presenting as functional dystonia

ALTERNATIVE: Paroxysmal dystonia with nonepileptic or epileptic impaired-awareness episodes

ALTERNATIVE: Genetic isolated dystonia, such as TOR1A- or THAP1-associated dystonia
